title: Fellowship - Diwali Celebrations
summary: DIWALI CELEBRATION – A FESTIVAL OF TOGETHERNESS : Rotary Club of Mumbai Elegant celebrated the festival of Diwali with great enthusiasm and festive spirit.
description: DIWALI CELEBRATION – A FESTIVAL OF TOGETHERNESS : Rotary Club of Mumbai Elegant celebrated the festival of Diwali with great enthusiasm and festive spirit. More than 180 members, along with their spouses, attended the celebration and enjoyed the festivities. The programme was filled with joy, laughter, music and togetherness, making it a memorable evening for everyone.
